name: Greater Norwich Local Plan
organisation-name: Broadland District Council, Norwich City Council, South Norfolk Council

housing-numbers.notes: Joint plan for three authorities. Required housing is 40,541 using government standard methodology. Total forecast supply is 45,041 homes including 11% buffer. Committed housing includes completions 2018-2022 (8,728) plus existing commitment at April 2022 (34,668). Allocated housing is homes forecast from allocated sites by March 2038. Windfall includes policy 7.5 delivery (795) plus windfall allowance (830).
